goal: Allow developers on regtest to generate blocks with multiple coinbase recipients and custom splits
Let generateblock automatically mine mempool transactions without manual raw block construction
agreement: Strong support for simulating protocols that pay multiple recipients from coinbase (supertestnet)
Resolved objection to modifying node miner logic for test-only code (maflcko)
Resolved objection to adding a new RPC instead of extending generateblock (andrewtoth)
Resolved objections over backwards compatibility and custom reward splits (achow101, stickies-v)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because it improves developer tooling for simulating mining pools on regtest
Simulates protocols like Ocean or Braidpool that pay multiple recipients directly from coinbase

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it expands generateblock to handle multiple outputs and mempool transaction inclusion
Eliminates boilerplate manual block construction in functional tests and developer workflows
